title: Two answers from one function
description:
A function can only `return` one value, but it can hand back more through reference parameters.

Write `void minMax(int a, int b, int c, int& smallest, int& largest)`. It stores the smallest of the three numbers in `smallest` and the largest in `largest`.
hints: Assigning to a reference parameter changes the caller's variable: `smallest = a;` really sets the variable the caller passed in.
Start both answers at `a`, then let `b` and `c` replace them when they are smaller or larger.
